description: This file contains helper functions and scripts used for testing interactive rebase features in a Git environment. It defines functions to set up fake editors, run specific rebase scenarios, and verify rebase behaviors, primarily used for testing rebase workflows and scripts.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Sets up a fake editor script to manipulate commit messages and rebase scripts during tests.

methods.name: set_cat_todo_editor
methods.description: Sets an editor that outputs only the rebase todo list, used for verification.

methods.name: test_linear_range
methods.description: Checks that a range of revisions forms a linear sequence with the expected subjects.

methods.name: reset_rebase
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing rebase, resets the branch, and cleans untracked files.

methods.name: cherry_pick
methods.description: Cherry-picks a commit and tags it with a given name.

methods.name: revert
methods.description: Reverts a commit and tags the revert.

methods.name: make_empty
methods.description: Creates an empty commit with a message and tags it.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Verifies that editor-related environment variables have not changed.

methods.name: set_reword_editor
methods.description: Sets up custom scripts to test reword commands in rebase.

methods.name: check_reworded_commits
methods.description: Verifies that commits have been reworded as expected after rebase.

methods.name: set_replace_editor
methods.description: Replaces the rebase todo list with specified contents for testing.
